title: 对话与社交系统体验不佳
description: 对话系统缺乏真实对话内容，选项无实际效果或逻辑，NPC互动僵硬重复，社交机制肤浅，导致玩家难以获得有意义的社交体验。
evidence: 敌人用脏话问候你在先，但是你不能回骂，只能嘲讽
they're all just generic lifeless drones moving back and forth doing nothing, there's no dialogue just "You talked to this NPC, +1 to like meter" type slop
对话交流选项那么多，聊几轮下来感觉也压根没什么变化

evidence_items.quote: The NPC interactions are extremely barebones, barely anything matters, despite it being such a massive complex system... it has basically zero effect for anything.
evidence_items.description: NPC互动极其简陋，对游戏几乎无影响
evidence_items.quote_zh: NPC互动极其简陋，几乎什么都不重要，尽管它是一个如此庞大复杂的系统……它对任何事情基本上都毫无影响。

evidence_items.quote: 对话交流选项那么多，聊几轮下来感觉也压根没什么变化
evidence_items.description: 对话选项多但聊几轮下来没什么变化
evidence_items.quote_zh: 对话交流选项那么多，聊几轮下来感觉也压根没什么变化

evidence_items.quote: Character dialogue is bad. I know the game is task-based, but conversations do not fit that model (wait, reply, wait, reply).
evidence_items.description: 对话采用等待-回复模式，与任务制不匹配
evidence_items.quote_zh: 角色对话很糟糕。我知道游戏是基于任务的，但对话并不适合那种模式（等待、回复、等待、回复）。

evidence_items.quote: the conversation bit is a pure joke
evidence_items.description: 对话内容很糟糕
evidence_items.quote_zh: 对话部分纯粹是个笑话

evidence_items.quote: Вроде болтаете и все такое, но часто вы несете чушь (Просто нет выбора сделать что то другое), так и к тому же это бесполезно. Текст ради текста
evidence_items.description: 对话通常是无意义的，没有选择做其他事情，文本只是为了文本。
evidence_items.quote_zh: 你们好像在聊天什么的，但经常说的都是废话（根本没有选择去做别的事），而且这还毫无用处。为了文本而文本。

evidence_items.quote: 敌人用脏话问候你在先，但是你不能回骂，只能嘲讽
evidence_items.description: 敌人先骂人但玩家不能回骂，只能嘲讽
evidence_items.quote_zh: 敌人用脏话问候你在先，但是你不能回骂，只能嘲讽

evidence_items.quote: There is hardly any unique dialogue outside of the rather few story missions.
evidence_items.description: NPC 对话平淡，故事任务外几乎没有独特对话
evidence_items.quote_zh: 除了相当少的故事任务之外，几乎没有任何独特的对话。

evidence_items.quote: they're all just generic lifeless drones moving back and forth doing nothing, there's no dialogue just "You talked to this NPC, +1 to like meter" type slop
evidence_items.description: NPC缺乏互动和对话，像无生命的无人机
evidence_items.quote_zh: 它们全都只是些毫无生气的通用无人机，来回移动，什么也不做，没有对话，只有“你和这个NPC交谈了，好感度+1”之类的垃圾

evidence_items.quote: interactions with NPCs are absurdly rigid and bare-bones, they feel more like RNG skill checks than people
evidence_items.description: NPC互动僵硬且内容单薄，像随机技能检定
evidence_items.quote_zh: 与NPC的互动极其死板且简陋，感觉更像是RNG技能检定而不是人

evidence_items.quote: no medical treatment or examination, no investigation until they inevitibly die because you can't interact with them at all
evidence_items.description: 无法对昏迷的NPC进行医疗或检查等互动
evidence_items.quote_zh: 没有医疗处理或检查，没有调查，直到他们不可避免地死去，因为你根本无法与他们互动

evidence_items.quote: every conversation goes to them insulting you, or brushing you off
evidence_items.description: 社交系统中NPC对话总是侮辱或敷衍玩家
evidence_items.quote_zh: 每次对话都会变成他们侮辱你，或者对你敷衍了事

evidence_items.quote: The whole world has about [b]FIFTY[/b] NPCs (lol), who differ only by name
evidence_items.description: 全世界只有约五十个NPC，且仅名字不同
evidence_items.quote_zh: 整个世界大约有[b]五十[/b]个NPC（笑），他们之间只有名字不同

evidence_items.quote: you cannot really have a dynamic convo but a simple back and forth with the same lines over and over
evidence_items.description: NPC对话静态重复，无法进行动态对话
evidence_items.quote_zh: 你无法真正进行动态对话，只能一遍又一遍地用同样的台词简单来回

evidence_items.quote: There also doesn't seem to be any dialogue whatsoever, character interactions are done through generic prompts such as "reassure" or "complain about authority"
evidence_items.description: 几乎没有对话，角色互动只有通用提示
evidence_items.quote_zh: 似乎也完全没有任何对话，角色互动都是通过诸如“安慰”或“抱怨权威”之类的通用提示来完成的

evidence_items.quote: NPCs have only procedural dialogue to spout, their requests have no meaningful rewards or intrigue
evidence_items.description: NPC只有程序生成的对话，没有有意义的互动
evidence_items.quote_zh: NPC只有程序生成的对话可以吐出来，他们的请求没有有意义的奖励或引人入胜之处

evidence_items.quote: the dialogue/social part of the game needs to be fleshed out
evidence_items.description: 对话和社交部分需要充实
evidence_items.quote_zh: 游戏的对话/社交部分需要进一步充实

evidence_items.quote: The dialog and mood system is just terrible
evidence_items.description: NPC对话和情绪系统很糟糕
evidence_items.quote_zh: 对话和情绪系统简直太糟糕了

evidence_items.quote: the dialogue choices are really just a choice of whatever stat you want to raise or lower, and as a result a lot of conversations are entirely nonsensical
evidence_items.description: 对话选项只是选择要提升或降低的属性，导致对话内容毫无逻辑
evidence_items.quote_zh: 对话选项实际上只是选择你想提升或降低哪项属性，结果就是很多对话完全莫名其妙

evidence_items.quote: The NPCs are still a bit rough
evidence_items.description: NPC表现粗糙
evidence_items.quote_zh: NPC们还是有点粗糙

evidence_items.quote: Conversations are basically all the same and meaningless.
evidence_items.description: 对话基本都一样且毫无意义
evidence_items.quote_zh: 对话基本上全都一样，而且毫无意义。

evidence_items.quote: All characters are randomly generated set of very few details.
evidence_items.description: 所有角色都是随机生成的，细节极少
evidence_items.quote_zh: 所有角色都是随机生成的、只有极少细节的集合。

evidence_items.quote: conversations were either hard to discern what to say or entirely oblivion NPC level convos
evidence_items.description: 对话难以辨别或像湮灭NPC
evidence_items.quote_zh: 对话要么很难分辨该说什么，要么完全是《上古卷轴4：湮没》NPC级别的对话

evidence_items.quote: I haven't tried myself but apparently crew npc ai is not very smart. Working solo seems to be the way until further updates.
evidence_items.description: 船员NPC AI不智能，建议单人游玩
evidence_items.quote_zh: 我自己还没试过，但据说船员NPC的AI不太聪明。在后续更新之前，独自工作似乎才是正道。

evidence_items.quote: The Combat and Dialogue system leave something to be desired
evidence_items.description: 对话系统不尽如人意
evidence_items.quote_zh: 战斗和对话系统还有待改进

evidence_items.quote: Social needs and dialog are also rudimentary as far as what you can do with them, but the framework is there for it to become something much deeper.
evidence_items.description: 社交需求和对话系统非常基础，可做的事情有限。
evidence_items.quote_zh: 社交需求和对话，就你能用它们做的事情而言，也很简陋，但框架已经在那里，可以让它变得深入得多。

evidence_items.quote: The conversation system is awkward
evidence_items.description: 对话系统使用起来很别扭
evidence_items.quote_zh: 对话系统很别扭
